options.operatorOrRoute: Prepaid Airport Taxi / Private Cab via NH181 (Kotagiri/Coonoor Ghats)
options.notes: Direct point-to-point drop at your hotel. Fixed government counters available at arrivals.

options.operatorOrRoute: Nilgiri Mountain Railway (NMR) via Mettupalayam Junction
options.durationRange: 4.5 - 5 hrs (plus 1 hr road transfer to Mettupalayam)
options.heritageNote: UNESCO World Heritage 'Toy Train' featuring 16 tunnels, 250 bridges, and historic Swiss rack-and-pinion steam ascent.

bookingReality.advanceBookingWindow: IRCTC reservation opens 120 days in advance and sells out within minutes during season (Apr-Jun, Sep-Dec).
bookingReality.spotQueueAdvisory: Unreserved general ticket counter at Mettupalayam opens around 05:00 AM. Requires queuing 2–3 hours in advance for ~30 unreserved seats with a severe risk of not getting a ticket.
bookingReality.actionableTip: If tickets are sold out online, take a comfortable direct taxi up to Ooty on arrival and book the shorter local 2-hour Joyride (Ooty ➔ Coonoor) or downhill return leg where availability is much easier.

options.notes: Requires taking a taxi/bus (~35 km / 1 hr) from Coimbatore Airport to Mettupalayam Station first. Departs Mettupalayam at 07:10 AM daily. Advance IRCTC reservation essential as seats sell out 60-120 days early.

options.operatorOrRoute: TNSTC / SETC Deluxe Express via Gandhipuram Central Bus Stand
options.notes: Buses depart every 15-20 minutes from Gandhipuram Central Bus Stand (10 km from CJB airport).

recommendation.reason: Direct 2.5 hr door-to-door transfer via NH181 is most practical when arriving with flight luggage, saving ~3 hours over multi-leg bus or early morning train transfers.
recommendation.experienceAlternative: The UNESCO World Heritage Nilgiri Mountain Railway Toy Train from Mettupalayam is an unforgettable historic journey — book IRCTC First Class well in advance or take it on your return trip down the valley.

options.operatorOrRoute: Prepaid Bagdogra Airport Taxi / Shared Cab via Rohini Tea Valley / Hill Cart Rd
options.notes: Direct scenic route through Kurseong and sprawling tea gardens. Prepaid counter right outside baggage claim.

options.operatorOrRoute: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (DHR) from New Jalpaiguri (NJP) / Kurseong
options.durationRange: 7 - 7.5 hrs (plus 45 min transfer from Bagdogra to NJP)
options.heritageNote: UNESCO World Heritage DHR 'Toy Train' engineered in 1881 with famous Batasia Loop and Ghum station (highest in India at 7,407 ft).

bookingReality.advanceBookingWindow: Full-route NJP-Darjeeling toy train runs only once daily and fills 60–90 days ahead on IRCTC. Darjeeling-Ghum Steam Joy Rides also sell out weeks early in peak season (Oct-Nov, Apr-May).
bookingReality.spotQueueAdvisory: Station booking counter at Darjeeling/NJP has long lines in the morning; unreserved seats are extremely limited.
bookingReality.actionableTip: Take a direct 3-hr taxi from Bagdogra Airport to your Darjeeling hotel on arrival day, and pre-book a dedicated 2-hour Darjeeling ➔ Ghum ➔ Batasia Loop Joy Ride for day 2 or 3.

options.notes: Requires transferring to NJP Junction (~18 km). Full NJP to Darjeeling toy train runs once daily (08:30 AM). Alternatively, book the 2-hour Joy Ride from Darjeeling to Ghum.

options.operatorOrRoute: NBSTC / Private Minibus via Siliguri Tenzing Norgay Bus Terminus
options.notes: Buses operate frequently from Siliguri bus terminal (14 km from Bagdogra airport).

recommendation.reason: Direct 3-hour private cab via Rohini tea valley is the fastest and most reliable mountain transfer when arriving with luggage.
recommendation.experienceAlternative: Experience the UNESCO World Heritage Darjeeling Himalayan Railway Joy Ride between Darjeeling and Ghum loop during your stay.
